ms.report:
1. Share a link to live documentation and usage examples for Apollo, Snek, and Bursa
We are currently building a comprehensive list of usage examples at https://andamio.notion.site/Documentation-and-Usage-Examples-63d9789ae5bd4c0e940fbc63cda3ef17, that will be demonstrated in the upcoming Cardano Go Project-Based Learning Course (launching June 2024): https://www.andamio.io/course/gpbl2024.
As a preview of the course, we published usage examples of Apollo, Snek (now known as "Adder"), and Bursa:
・Apollo: https://www.andamio.io/course/gpbl2024/100/lesson/1
・Adder: https://www.andamio.io/course/gpbl2024/100/lesson/3
・Bursa: https://www.andamio.io/course/gpbl2024/100/lesson/2

These examples will be integrated into illustrative mini-applications in the upcoming course.

ms.promise:
By developing documentation and usage examples, and by hosting weekly community meetings, we will create the raw material for a sequence of project-based learning modules that any developer can use to learn build Cardano applications using the Go programming language.
In this milestone, we will publish a free and open course titled "Cardano Go Project-Based Learning". The course will be shared widely and open to anyone who wants to enroll.
By completing the course, developers will be able to earn contribution credentials, so that they can earn rewards for continued contribution to open-source Cardano Go libraries.
・

ms.promise:
At the end of this project, we will have:
・A public release of Andamio CLI
・A record of improvements to existing libraries
・Documentation and onboarding resources (text, video, and code examples) for developers
・Data about the viability of our open-source funding model
・An archive of blog posts and community meetings for reference
・A project closeout report and video to summarize the project

If we are successful, we will have a story to tell that resonates beyond the Cardano Ecosystem, about how the software and processes we are building help people to spend more time contributing to meaningful projects.
